title: Novena to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
description: A nine-day devotion to the Immaculate Heart of Mary, focusing on her maternal love, purity of heart, and powerful intercession. This novena emphasizes Mary's role as Mother of the Church and her desire to lead all souls to her Son Jesus.
intention: For purity of heart, maternal protection, family healing, world peace, and conversion of sinners through Mary's intercession
instructions: Pray this novena for 9 consecutive days, ideally beginning on a Saturday in honor of Our Lady. The Immaculate Heart of Mary is closely connected to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, and this devotion often includes consecration to Mary's heart. Include your personal intentions while also praying for world peace and the conversion of sinners, which are close to Mary's heart.
background_info: Devotion to the Immaculate Heart of Mary has ancient roots but was particularly emphasized after the apparitions at Fatima (1917), where Mary asked for devotion to her Immaculate Heart as a means of obtaining peace for the world. Her heart represents her pure love for God and her maternal love for all humanity. The feast was established by Pope Pius XII in 1944 and is celebrated the day after the Sacred Heart of Jesus, emphasizing the unity of these two devoted hearts.

days.title: Day 1: The Purity of Mary's Heart
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Heart of Mary, pure and spotless, you were conceived without sin and remained free from all stain throughout your life. Your heart was always perfectly aligned with God's will, never tainted by selfishness, pride, or any form of evil. I come to you today asking you to help me purify my own heart. Cleanse me from all sin and help me to desire what is good, holy, and pleasing to God. When I am tempted to think, speak, or act in ways that would displease your Son, strengthen my resolve to choose what is right. Help me to see with clear eyes, to judge with wisdom, and to love with a pure heart like yours. Remove from my heart all bitterness, resentment, jealousy, and impurity. Fill it instead with faith, hope, charity, and all the virtues that made your heart so beautiful. Teach me to pray as you prayed, to trust as you trusted, and to surrender to God's will as completely as you did. O Immaculate Heart of Mary, make my heart pure like yours. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary's Immaculate Heart is our model of purity - not just physical purity, but purity of intention, thought, and desire. She shows us what a human heart looks like when it is completely open to God and free from the stain of sin.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, purify my heart and help me to desire only what is good and holy. Make my heart like yours in its love for God.
days.scripture: "Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God." - Matthew 5:8

days.title: Day 2: Mary's Maternal Love
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Heart of Mary, loving Mother of Jesus and our Mother too, your heart is filled with tender compassion for all your children. Just as you cared for Jesus with perfect love, you care for each of us with the same maternal devotion. You understand our struggles, our fears, our hopes, and our needs. I come to you today as your child, asking for your maternal protection and guidance. When I feel alone or abandoned, remind me that you are always near, ready to comfort and strengthen me. Help me to turn to you in times of trouble as naturally as a child turns to their mother. Teach me to trust in your care and to find peace in your love. I ask your maternal intercession for all my needs [mention specific intentions], but especially for the grace to be a good child to you and a faithful follower of your Son. Watch over my family, my friends, and all those I love. Protect us from spiritual and physical harm, and guide us always toward what is best for our souls. O Immaculate Heart of Mary, be our Mother in all things. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary's maternal heart extends to every person, not just her own Son. When Jesus gave her to us from the cross, saying 'Behold your mother,' he made her the Mother of all humanity. We can approach her with complete confidence in her love.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, thank you for being my mother. Help me to trust in your maternal care and to turn to you in all my needs.
days.scripture: "When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to her, 'Woman, here is your son,' and to the disciple, 'Here is your mother.'" - John 19:26-27

days.title: Day 3: Mary's Compassionate Heart
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Heart of Mary, you who stood beneath the cross and suffered with your Son, you know what it means to experience deep sorrow and pain. Your heart was pierced with a sword of grief as you watched Jesus suffer and die for our sins. Yet through all your suffering, your heart remained full of love and compassion for others. I come to you today in my own sufferings [mention specific sorrows or difficulties]. You understand pain in a way that brings comfort to those who suffer. Help me to unite my sufferings with yours and with those of Jesus, that they may become redemptive rather than merely painful. When I am tempted to become bitter or to lose hope, remind me of your example of faithful endurance. Teach me to find meaning in my difficulties and to offer them for the salvation of souls. Help me to have compassion for others who suffer, and show me how I can comfort them as you comfort me. O Immaculate Heart of Mary, Mother of Sorrows and Queen of Martyrs, be with me in my pain and help me to find healing in your love. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary's heart was pierced with sorrow at the cross, but this suffering deepened her compassion rather than hardening her heart. She understands our pain and can help us find redemptive meaning in our own sufferings.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, you who suffered so deeply, help me to unite my sufferings with yours and to find meaning in my pain.
days.scripture: "And a sword will pierce your own soul too." - Luke 2:35

days.title: Day 4: Mary's Heart of Faith
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Heart of Mary, woman of great faith, when the angel Gabriel announced God's plan to you, you believed even though you couldn't fully understand. Your heart was filled with such trust in God that you could say 'yes' to His will even when it seemed impossible. Throughout your life, you continued to believe even when circumstances were difficult or confusing. I ask you today to help me grow in faith like yours. When God's will is unclear to me or when His plans seem different from my own, help me to trust as you trusted. Strengthen my faith when I face trials, doubts, or uncertainties. Help me to believe in God's goodness even when I cannot see how things will work out. Teach me to say 'yes' to God as generously as you did, even when His requests seem challenging or costly. When I am tempted to doubt God's love or His care for me, remind me of your example of unwavering faith. Help me to ponder God's word in my heart as you did, and to find in Scripture the strength and guidance I need. O Immaculate Heart of Mary, woman of faith, increase my faith in your Son. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary's faith was tested many times - from the Annunciation to the foot of the cross - but she never wavered in her trust in God. Her heart of faith is our model for believing in God's goodness even when circumstances are difficult.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, strengthen my faith and help me to trust in God's plan as completely as you did.
days.scripture: "Blessed is she who believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!" - Luke 1:45

days.title: Day 5: Mary's Heart of Intercession
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Heart of Mary, powerful intercessor before the throne of God, you who obtained the first miracle at the wedding feast of Cana by interceding with your Son, continue to intercede for us today. Your heart is always attentive to our needs, and your prayers are always heard by Jesus. I come to you today with my petitions, knowing that you will present them to your Son with a mother's love and concern. I ask your intercession for [mention specific intentions]. You know what we need even before we ask, and you know how to pray for us better than we know how to pray for ourselves. When our prayers seem to go unanswered, help us to trust that God is working in ways we cannot see. Teach us to pray with persistence and faith, as you teach us in the Rosary. Help us to understand that sometimes the greatest answers to prayer are not what we expect but what God knows is best for our souls. Intercede especially for sinners, for families in crisis, for young people facing difficult decisions, and for all who have stopped believing in God's love. O Immaculate Heart of Mary, our advocate and intercessor, pray for us always. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary's intercession is powerful because of her unique relationship with Jesus as His mother and because of her perfect conformity to God's will. She continues to intercede for us as she did at Cana, always directing us to her Son.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, intercede for all my needs and help me to trust in the power of your prayers with Jesus.
days.scripture: "His mother said to the servants, 'Do whatever he tells you.'" - John 2:5

days.title: Day 6: Mary's Heart and Family Life
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Heart of Mary, Queen of Families, you who created such a loving home for Jesus in Nazareth, help all families to follow your example of love, faith, and devotion. Your heart understands the joys and challenges of family life - the daily sacrifices, the moments of worry, the deep bonds of love that unite family members. I pray today for my own family and for all families throughout the world. Where there is love, help it to grow stronger. Where there is conflict, bring peace and understanding. Where there is separation, work for reconciliation. Help parents to raise their children with wisdom and patience, teaching them to know and love God. Help children to honor and respect their parents, and to appreciate the sacrifices made for them. Protect families from the forces that would divide them - materialism, selfishness, lack of communication, and the pressures of modern life. Help families to pray together, to spend quality time together, and to support each other through difficulties. I especially pray for [mention specific family intentions]. O Immaculate Heart of Mary, make our families holy like the Holy Family of Nazareth. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary's heart was formed in family life - first in her own family with Saints Anne and Joachim, then in the Holy Family with Jesus and Joseph. She understands the beauty and challenges of family relationships and can help heal and strengthen our families.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, bless my family and all families. Help us to love and support each other as the Holy Family did.
days.scripture: "And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man." - Luke 2:52

days.title: Day 7: Mary's Heart and World Peace
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Heart of Mary, Queen of Peace, at Fatima you promised that through devotion to your Immaculate Heart, peace would come to the world. Your heart longs for harmony among all people and grieves over the wars, violence, and hatred that divide humanity. I pray today for peace in our world - peace between nations, peace in communities torn by violence, peace in families divided by conflict. Help world leaders to choose dialogue over warfare, understanding over prejudice, and cooperation over competition. Inspire people everywhere to work for justice, which is the foundation of true peace. Help us to recognize that peace begins in individual hearts - in my own heart first of all. Root out of my heart all anger, resentment, prejudice, and desire for revenge. Fill it instead with forgiveness, compassion, understanding, and love for all people, even those who are different from me or who have hurt me. Help me to be a peacemaker in my daily life, bringing harmony to my relationships and communities. Teach me to pray the Rosary as you requested, offering each decade for peace in the world. O Immaculate Heart of Mary, Queen of Peace, obtain for us the peace that only your Son can give. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary's desire for world peace is not just about ending wars but about creating a civilization of love where all people recognize their dignity as children of God. This peace must begin in our own hearts and relationships.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, Queen of Peace, help me to be a peacemaker and pray for peace throughout the world.
days.scripture: "Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God." - Matthew 5:9

days.title: Day 8: Mary's Heart and the Conversion of Sinners
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Heart of Mary, refuge of sinners, your heart is filled with compassion for all who have strayed from God's path. You do not condemn sinners but desire their conversion and return to your Son. You understand that even the worst sinners are still your children, capable of repentance and transformation through God's grace. I pray today for the conversion of sinners, beginning with my own need for ongoing conversion. Help me to recognize my sins honestly and to turn away from them with genuine repentance. Give me the grace to make a good confession and to amend my life. I also pray for those who seem far from God - family members who have lost their faith, friends who live as if God doesn't exist, public figures who promote values contrary to the Gospel, and all who have hardened their hearts against divine love. Soften their hearts as only you can, and create opportunities for them to encounter your Son's mercy. Help me to be an instrument of conversion through my prayers, good example, and patient love. Teach me never to judge or despair of anyone's salvation, remembering that your Son came to save sinners. O Immaculate Heart of Mary, refuge of sinners, pray for the conversion of all who need God's mercy. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Mary's heart grieves over sin not because she condemns sinners, but because she knows how sin harms her children and separates them from the happiness God wants them to have. Her prayers and ours can obtain the grace of conversion for even the most hardened hearts.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for the conversion of sinners, including myself. Help all your children to return to God's love.
days.scripture: "In the same way, I tell you, there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents." - Luke 15:10

days.title: Day 9: Consecration to the Immaculate Heart
days.opening_prayer:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. 

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: O Immaculate Heart of Mary, as I conclude this novena, I want to give myself completely to you. I consecrate myself, my life, my family, and all my intentions to your Immaculate Heart. Take me as your own child and help me to live always under your maternal protection and guidance. I give you my heart - with all its strengths and weaknesses, its joys and sorrows, its hopes and fears. Purify it, protect it, and make it like your own heart in its love for God and neighbor. Guide all my thoughts, words, and actions so that they may always please your Son and contribute to His glory. When I am faced with important decisions, help me to choose what is right. When I am tempted to sin, strengthen me to resist. When I suffer, help me to unite my pain with yours and with your Son's. Use me as an instrument of your love in the world, helping others to know and love Jesus through my example and prayers. I promise to honor you always, to pray the Rosary regularly, to practice devotion to your Immaculate Heart, and to encourage others to love you too. Accept this consecration and keep me faithful to it throughout my life. O Immaculate Heart of Mary, I am yours forever. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, pray for us.
days.reflection: Consecration to Mary's Immaculate Heart is not worship of Mary but a commitment to let her lead us more perfectly to Jesus. When we give ourselves to her, she forms us in holiness and presents us to her Son as her gift to Him.
days.intention_prayer: Immaculate Heart of Mary, I consecrate myself to you. Help me to live faithfully as your child and to follow you always to Jesus.
days.scripture: "My soul glorifies the Lord and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior." - Luke 1:46-47

source: Traditional Catholic Novena to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
notes: This novena can be prayed at any time but is especially meaningful during May (Mary's month), in preparation for the feast of the Immaculate Heart of Mary, or in connection with First Saturday devotions. The Immaculate Heart devotion is closely linked to the message of Fatima and includes practices such as the Five First Saturdays, the Rosary, and acts of reparation. Many people conclude this novena with a formal act of consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary.
